basis: Measured at smoke scale on the VM (load avg ~62-95, so an inflated upper bound; a dedicated unloaded cpu-mid pod is faster). The attn-learned GD arm was rewritten from a serial per-fold loop (which alone projected >14h across 224 cells — the banned vectorize-many-cell-fits anti-pattern) into a fully batched all-folds x all-L2 fit in a PCA-reduced (rank-32) space; the batched training core measures ~21ms/epoch x 1200 epochs = ~25s/cell x 224 cells ~ 1.6h at load-95 (likely 0.4-0.8h unloaded). The remaining cost is the plan-mandated per-position PCA-to-10 for the unpooled ceiling (34 SVDs of (49,3584) x 50 folds x 224 cells, closed-form, NOT the GD anti-pattern) + the 1000-iter selection-symmetric shuffle + B=2000 cluster bootstrap. Total fit-phase wall projects ~1.5-3h vs the plan's 0.5h. This is 0-GPU-h throughout; the whole run is a few CPU-hours. No self-descope applied (orchestrator owns descope: e.g. drop shuffle iters to 500, or accept the longer CPU wall since GPU-h=0).
